name: Forfiles.exe
description: Selects and executes a command on a file or set of files. This command is useful for batch processing.
author: Oddvar Moe

commands.description: Executes specified command since there is a match for notepad.exe in the c:\windows\System32 folder.
commands.usecase: Use forfiles to start a new process to evade defensive counter measures
commands.os: Windows vista, Windows 7, Windows 8, Windows 8.1, Windows 10, Windows 11

commands.description: Executes the evil.exe Alternate Data Stream (AD) since there is a match for notepad.exe in the c:\windows\system32 folder.
commands.usecase: Use forfiles to start a new process from a binary hidden in an alternate data stream
commands.os: Windows vista, Windows 7, Windows 8, Windows 8.1, Windows 10, Windows 11
